package.name: gcs_comms
package.description: GCS communication bridge: raw-MAVLink link to the ground control station over Channel B (ICD §4.1/§4.2, gcs_mavlink_node) — GCS command decode, link-status heartbeat monitoring (GCS-001), the mission upload state machine (GCS-002, SDD §11.2, ICD §4.6), and the MC_STATUS/MC_DETECTION/MC_HEALTH telemetry multiplexer (GCS-003, SDD §11.3) — plus the Mission Orchestrator's Channel C mission-plan library over MAVFTP (GCS-004, ICD §12, mission_orchestrator_node). mc_mavlink_defs.xml documents the custom-message wire format for both nodes; each hand-packs/hand-decodes them (see their own comments) rather than adding a mavgen codegen step. SDD-MC-001 §11. SRS refs: FR-060-064, IR-010-014.
